name: Wind Status
description: Show the current wind direction.

name: Set Wind
description: Set the current wind direction without consuming a scroll or advancing time.

parameters.name: Direction
parameters.description: Choose the new live wind direction.

name: Logging Status
description: Show global logging, level, output, and category state.

name: Shrine Atlas
description: Inspect immutable shrine reference data alongside current progression state.

name: Shrine Progress Alteration
description: Atomically update actual shrine quest and ruined-state variables without awarding rewards.

parameters.name: Shrine
parameters.description: Choose the shrine whose live progression state will change.

parameters.name: Quest State
parameters.description: Set the normalized completed/active flag combination without replaying rewards.

parameters.name: Shrine Condition
parameters.description: Set whether Blackthorn has ruined the shrine.

name: Party Character Roster
description: Inspect the detached full roster, stable numeric indices, and review fingerprint.

name: Character Alteration
description: Atomically update safe character attributes, resources, status, or party position. Combat permits current HP and MP only.

parameters.name: Character
parameters.description: Select a current active-party member.

parameters.name: Strength
parameters.description: Leave unset to preserve the current value.

parameters.name: Dexterity
parameters.description: Leave unset to preserve the current value.

parameters.name: Intelligence
parameters.description: Lower values clamp current MP to the new maximum.

parameters.name: Current HP
parameters.description: Exact living HP; zero and death transitions are intentionally excluded.

parameters.name: Current MP
parameters.description: Exact MP, validated against the resulting Intelligence value.

parameters.name: Experience
parameters.description: Exact XP without forcing level or maximum-HP progression.

parameters.name: Level
parameters.description: Set level, minimum XP, and level-derived maximum HP without healing or stat boosts.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: Safe non-dead status; leave unset to preserve the current status.

parameters.name: Party Position
parameters.description: Swap with an occupied position; the Avatar must remain first.

name: Maximize Active Levels
description: Raise every reviewed active roster member to level eight and restore progression-derived resources.

name: Set Party Status
description: Atomically set an explicit status for one or a reviewed list of stable active roster indices.

name: Fill Active Party
description: Fill every open active-party position from the reviewed roster using authoritative composition rules.

name: Add Roster Member
description: Add one reviewed inactive member by stable numeric roster index.

name: Calendar Status
description: Show the current Britannian date, time, turn, and moon phase.

name: Set Calendar Time
description: Set the exact hour and minute without advancing game time.

name: Set Calendar Day
description: Set the day of the current month without advancing game time.

name: Nearby Search Status
description: Inspect the Avatar's current and four adjacent cells, authentic search progress, and detached item stacks.

name: Add Search Item Stack
description: Add or merge a supported provision at a logical coordinate on the current map.

parameters.name: X
parameters.description: Coordinate on the active map.

parameters.name: Y
parameters.description: Coordinate on the active map.

name: Reset One-Time Search Progress
description: Destructively clear only authentic one-time search-location found flags.

name: Quest Item Status
description: Show all authentic quest items, quantities, categories, and known canonical placements.

name: Grant Quest Item
description: Add one quest item only when it is absent.

parameters.name: Quest Item
parameters.description: Choose one stable quest-item identity.

name: Remove Quest Item
description: Destructively remove the complete quantity of one quest item from inventory.

parameters.name: Quest Item
parameters.description: Choose one stable quest-item identity.

name: Position Status
description: Show current location, map type, coordinates, logical maxima, and available floor range.

name: Travel to Landmark
description: Transition to a curated shrine, quest, or Flame landmark without simulating travel time.

name: Moongate Status
description: Show current phase, visibility, activation state, all moonstones, and the computed destination without travelling.

name: Encounter Options
description: List maps, entry directions, count modes, and spawnable monsters.

name: Start Encounter
description: Validate, compose, and synchronously start a tactical encounter, or load a fixed dungeon room as authored.

name: Monster Ecosystem
description: Show current-map generation and enemy state.

name: Set Monster Generation
description: Set natural generation enabled state and inclusive roll maximum; 30 matches the original.

name: Clear Map Enemies
description: Remove hostile current-map units while preserving friendlies and vehicles.

name: Spawn Whirlpool
description: Attempt a forced valid whirlpool spawn.

name: Spawn Pirate
description: Attempt a forced valid pirate spawn.

name: Ships
description: Inspect the boarded party vehicle and exceptional frigate test state.

name: Spawn Vehicle
description: Spawn a frigate or skiff at the Avatar or an authoritative overworld dock without advancing time.

parameters.name: Dock
parameters.description: Required only when placement is Dock.

name: Force Board Vehicle
description: Replace the party vehicle in a supported world context. Intentionally bypasses terrain restrictions.

name: Damage Ship Hull
description: Apply non-sinking raw hull damage.

name: Repair Ship Hull
description: Restore the current frigate to full hull strength.

name: Set Frigate Skiffs
description: Set the exact Redux attached-skiff quantity.

name: Locker Status
description: Show a detached, complete inventory locker snapshot.

name: Set Provision
description: Synchronously set one provision quantity after verifying its reviewed value.

name: Provision Preset
description: Apply an absolute reviewed provision locker preset.

parameters.name: Expected Snapshot
parameters.description: Exact locker snapshot fingerprint returned by Locker Status.

name: Set Reagent
description: Synchronously set one Reagent quantity after verifying its reviewed value.

name: Reagent Preset
description: Apply an absolute reviewed reagent locker preset.

choices.label: Set Non-Garlic Reagents to 20 and Clear Garlic

parameters.name: Expected Snapshot
parameters.description: Exact locker snapshot fingerprint returned by Locker Status.

name: Add Potion
description: Add a positive amount to one potion stack.

name: Potion Preset
description: Apply an absolute reviewed potion locker preset.

parameters.name: Expected Snapshot
parameters.description: Exact locker snapshot fingerprint returned by Locker Status.

name: Add Scroll
description: Add a positive amount to one scroll stack.

name: Scroll Preset
description: Apply an absolute reviewed scroll locker preset.

parameters.name: Expected Snapshot
parameters.description: Exact locker snapshot fingerprint returned by Locker Status.

name: Set Equipment
description: Synchronously set one Equipment quantity after verifying its reviewed value.

name: Equipment Preset
description: Apply an absolute reviewed equipment locker preset.

choices.label: Set Every Bow to 5 and Clear Ammo

parameters.name: Expected Snapshot
parameters.description: Exact locker snapshot fingerprint returned by Locker Status.

name: Grant Equipment Preset
description: Add five matching equipment items after reviewing the locker snapshot.

choices.label: Add 5 of Every Bow and Clear Ammo

parameters.name: Expected Snapshot
parameters.description: Exact locker snapshot fingerprint returned by Locker Status.

name: Clear All Equipment
description: Destroy every carried equipment item and clear all 16 roster loadouts after reviewing the complete equipment state.

parameters.name: Expected Snapshot
parameters.description: Exact locker snapshot fingerprint returned by Locker Status.

name: Prepared Spell Inventory
description: Inspect all 48 prepared spell quantities, independent magical light, and the active duration spell.

name: Set Prepared Spell
description: Set one exact prepared spell quantity after verifying its reviewed value.

name: Maximum Prepared Spells
description: Set all 48 castable prepared spell quantities to 99 after reviewing the spell snapshot.

parameters.name: Expected Snapshot
parameters.description: Exact prepared spell snapshot fingerprint returned by Prepared Spell Inventory.

name: Set Effect Duration
description: Set exact active-spell turns or magical-light minutes after checking both reviewed effects.

name: Activate Duration Effect
description: Activate independent Light or the Time Stop spell at authentic duration after checking reviewed effect state.

name: Active Combat
description: Inspect the tactical map, combatants, conditions, and DEX queue without advancing combat.

name: Set Monster Sleep
description: Set one live monster's sleep condition at a quiescent player-turn boundary.

name: Discard Active Encounter
description: Discard one reviewed tactical encounter and return to its pre-combat location without resolving victory, defeat, evacuation, or overworld contact.

name: Spawn Reinforcements
description: Atomically add a reviewed monster batch at unoccupied authoritative combat-map positions.

name: Reset Gameplay RNG Seed
description: Reset the global gameplay RNG from a reviewed active encounter; all subsequent gameplay randomness, including post-combat randomness, uses the new seed.

name: Damage Monster
description: Apply bounded raw damage to one reviewed stable combatant; lethal damage synchronizes the queue and victory but awards no XP and creates no corpse or treasure.

name: Kill Monster
description: Defeat one reviewed stable combatant, synchronize the queue, and trigger victory when none remain; awards no XP and creates no corpse or treasure.

name: Kill All Monsters
description: Defeat every monster in the exact reviewed snapshot, synchronize the queue, and trigger victory; awards no XP and creates no corpses or treasure.

name: Clear All Monsters
description: Remove manager and queue monsters from the exact reviewed snapshot without XP, objects, or victory.

name: Set Logging
description: Explicitly enable or disable process-wide categorized logging.

name: Set Stdout Logging
description: Explicitly enable or disable accepted log output to stdout.

name: Set Logging Level
description: Set the process-wide minimum accepted logging level.

name: Set Logging Category
description: Explicitly enable or disable one categorized logging channel.

name: Set All Logging Categories
description: Explicitly enable or disable every known categorized logging channel.

name: Set Lighting Overlay
description: Show or hide game-window light-distance diagnostics.

name: Set Search Overlay
description: Show or hide authentic search locations in the game window.

name: Set Moongate Overlay
description: Show or hide moonstone and moongate diagnostics in the game window.

name: Set Combat Speed
description: Persist master combat animation and action-pause speed. Higher values shorten presentation without changing combat rules.

name: Guard Status
description: Inspect criminal state, potential guards, and current hostility.

name: Shadowlord Status
description: Inspect life, summoned presence, and deterministic town assignments.

name: Death Status
description: Inspect party mortality and authoritative resurrection consequences.

name: Debug Options
description: Inspect gameplay overrides and game-window diagnostic rendering options.

name: Set Free Move
description: Explicitly enable or disable collision-free Avatar movement.

name: Set Text Placeholders
description: Show or hide empty-line placeholders in game-window text output.

name: Set Dialog Bounds
description: Show or hide dialog text-area bounds in the game window.

name: Set Unlimited Casting Resources
description: Cast without prepared spells or current MP consumption while preserving magical-ability requirements.

name: Set Spell Level Bypass
description: Allow magical characters to cast spells above their current level.

name: Set Party Karma
description: Set party-wide karma exactly without applying a moral event or advancing time.

name: Test Setups
description: Inspect the active party and run the camping and death test setups.

name: Test Hole Up
description: Queue production camping with explicit wanderer and ambush branches against a reviewed party roster.

parameters.name: Guard Roster Index
parameters.description: Optional stable active-party roster index.

name: Test Search
description: Queue the production Search action using dispatch for the current map type.

name: Travel Through Moongate
description: Queue production moongate travel only while source and route still match reviewed status.

name: Use Shard
description: Queue the production shard workflow for one explicitly reviewed shard and live quest state.

name: Apply Usable Inventory Preset
description: Apply exact reviewed targets for every quest item, moonstone, potion, and scroll.

name: Test Telescope
description: Queue the production telescope workflow using the current Britannian time and small-map context.

name: Test Spyglass
description: Queue the production spyglass workflow after validating ownership and its above-ground small-map context.

name: Test Crystal Ball
description: Queue the production crystal-ball selection and deterministic intelligence-check workflow on a small map.

name: Kill Active Party
description: Atomically set every member in the reviewed active party to zero HP and Dead without starting resurrection.

name: Test Death Sequence
description: Atomically wipe the reviewed active party and queue the production death and resurrection workflow.

name: Set All Shrine Quest States
description: Atomically clear or complete every shrine quest after reviewing the complete shrine quest state.

name: List Save Snapshots
description: List detached metadata and current eligibility for named and rollback snapshots.

name: Inspect Save Snapshot
description: Inspect detached metadata and a compact gameplay summary without returning the full snapshot.

name: Capture Save Snapshot
description: Capture the stable active gameplay scene as a new immutable project or personal snapshot.

name: Load Save Snapshot
description: Persist an automatic rollback, build a dormant candidate, and atomically replace the active scene.

name: Delete Save Snapshot
description: Delete a project or personal snapshot only at the reviewed revision.

parameters.name: Destination
parameters.description: Choose Britannia/Underworld, a small location, or a dungeon.

parameters.name: Floor
parameters.description: Choose a floor valid for an exact destination.

name: Clear Fixed Dungeon Room
description: Defeat every hostile enemy in an authoritative fixed dungeon room and declare victory; awards no XP and creates no corpses or treasure.

name: Merchant Tester
description: Inspect all canonical merchants and current Preview and Live launch availability.

name: Open Merchant Preview
description: Open the production merchant presentation and stop before transaction authority.

parameters.name: Merchant
parameters.description: Choose one canonical active merchant identity.

name: Open Live Merchant Session
description: Open a reviewed production merchant session, loading the canonical town when required.

parameters.name: Merchant
